purpose: minimal extension of existing per-story multi-input review, not new performance index or design optimization

scope.comparison: existing paired baselineB versus referenceM, separately byX/Y input set
scope.demand_model: referenceM explicitly selected for maximum absolute shear demand; not maximum across heterogeneous models
scope.native_output: Story Forces Bottom as exported; no damper subtraction or subject-body force reconstruction

records.improvement_control: all argmin_c(1-PM_sc/PB_sc),PB>0 within same direction and paired input set
records.demand_control: all argmax_c PM_sc within same set
records.paired_columns: PB,PM,tB,tM,A,d,r all from the selected same Story/Direction/input
records.not_pairwise: never substitute maxPB from another input or maxPM into the minimum-reduction record
records.ties: retain all tied inputs or predeclare listing rule with tie flags
records.same_input_both_purposes: may merge display but preserve both purpose flags

metrics_existing_only.zeroPB: relative metrics undefined, retain absolute peaks and flag
metrics_existing_only.time_meaning: tB/tM are each model own saved absolute peak; no same-time force claim
metrics_existing_only.d_not: phase angle, damper contribution or peak-time shift divided by period

csv_header_file: review-table-header.csv,header-only requested schema, no data rows
four_step_use: verify pair/units/grid; retain complete paired peaks and original directional ranges
select both minimum-improvement and maximum-reference-demand records at every floor/direction
inspect each selected input own control windows; compare with same-input bottom and arithmetic layer mean
use demand to locate further checks, then existing capacity/combined-force/drift checks separately

engineering_objections.min_reduction: relative improvement only, not highest remaining demand or most dangerous floor
engineering_objections.max_PM: largest chosen-model software shear demand, not capacity utilization or structural danger rank
engineering_objections.capacity: no new capacity/demand ratio without section/combined-force evidence
engineering_objections.unpaired_models: two-record selection cannot restore causal inference when model/input pairing is incomplete
engineering_objections.no_threshold_or_score: no new acceptance threshold, composite score, damper layout or prioritization optimization

existing_manuscript_example.status: quoted existing manuscript values, not recomputed or new evidence
existing_manuscript_example.interpretation: bottom/average omission of limited local improvement; not proof of maximum absolute demand or capacity-critical Story7

role6_critique: Received during current task; selectedM definition, same-input rows, capacity separation and causal-pairing limit incorporated.
pending: role4 selection of actual maximum-demand controlling inputs from frozen168-record small table
role2 independent check of new table numbers before manuscript integration
role2/role6 review of method and engineering wording
author_paragraph: included in one-page method note; role5 alone edits manuscript
